Many people choose the safety of the script over the vulnerability of genuine, unscripted thought.

Some people spend very little time reflecting on *how* they think or *why* they react. They are running on the operating system they were given, never questioning it. You, by noticing this "script" phenomenon, are engaging in high-level metacognition. You're looking at the code of social interaction, while they are just running the program.
